meaning:
δειλιάω, -ῶ
(δειλία), [in LXX for חתת ni., פּחד, etc. ;]
= the more frequently ἀποδ-, to be cowardly, timid, fearful: Jhn.14:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
